stories.headline: Prabowo announces centralized commodity export control through new state entity, markets spooked
stories.summary: President Prabowo unveiled a sweeping plan at a May 20 parliament plenary to route exports of coal, palm oil, and ferronickel through a new state enterprise, PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI), arguing it will curb under-invoicing and boost government revenues amid dwindling reserves exacerbated by the Iran war. International and domestic analysts warned the policy risks rattling investors already concerned about policy transparency, with Bloomberg and Bloomberg Opinion publishing pieces likening the trajectory to pre-1997 crisis conditions.

stories.headline: Rupiah hits record lows as Bank Indonesia delivers surprise 50bp rate hike and tightens dollar controls
stories.summary: The Indonesian rupiah slid to successive record lows against the dollar in the week of May 18-24, prompting Bank Indonesia to raise its benchmark rate by 50 basis points to 5.25% on May 20 — the first hike in two years and double the expected increment — while also restricting dollar purchases and extending export earnings retention requirements. Analysts warned further hikes may be needed as investor confidence remains fragile due to concerns about policy transparency and government spending plans.

stories.headline: Vice President Gibran conducts extensive working visit to NTT, highlighting infrastructure gaps and food sovereignty projects
stories.summary: VP Gibran Rakabuming Raka conducted a multi-day working visit to Nusa Tenggara Timur from May 21-23, visiting the National Salt Industry Center (K-SIGN) in Rote Ndao, making an unscheduled stop in isolated Amfoang after hearing student grievances, and inspecting broken bridges and seaweed farming communities. Coverage was heavy from local NTT outlets; a viral side story emerged when Cipayung Plus student groups protested the visit over unresolved land compensation, and the NTT governor sparked a minor controversy for appearing to use his phone during community dialogues.

stories.headline: PDI-P consolidates for 2029 elections through nationwide branch assemblies (Musancab)
stories.summary: PDI-P held simultaneous branch-level organizational assemblies (Musancab) across Java and Bali during the week of May 18-24, with provincial-level coordination in Central Java, East Java, and Bali focusing on grassroots consolidation and recruiting Gen Z members ahead of the 2029 elections. The party's sole opposition status was repeatedly cited by organizers as motivation for strengthened mobilization.

stories.headline: Prabowo praises PDI-P as opposition at parliament plenary, sparking public exchange on democratic checks
stories.summary: During his May 20 parliament address, President Prabowo publicly thanked PDI-P for serving as the sole opposition party, calling it a sacrifice for democracy while also expressing personal hurt at sharp criticism from the party. PDI-P responded that its opposition role is its constitutional duty; Puan Maharani confirmed the party will continue constructive criticism, while Prabowo separately told parliament he believes executive accountability requires outside oversight.

stories.headline: Golkar consolidates regional branches and signals openness to backing Prabowo-Gibran second term
stories.summary: Golkar held dozens of regional leadership assemblies (Musda/Muscam) across the country during the week, while the party's national leadership publicly signaled openness to formally supporting a Prabowo-Gibran second term — though stating a formal decision had not yet been made. Pro-Jokowi volunteer group Bara JP also declared support for a second Prabowo-Gibran term, citing instructions from the former president.

stories.headline: Pertamina publicly denies viral hoax claiming Pertalite fuel restrictions for certain vehicle brands from June 1
stories.summary: A social media hoax claiming that vehicles with engines above 1,400cc would be banned from purchasing subsidized Pertalite fuel starting June 1, 2026, spread widely and was denied multiple times by Pertamina Patra Niaga's corporate secretary. The company stated no government directive or regulation existed for such a restriction and urged the public to verify information through official channels.

stories.headline: Gerindra holds North Sulawesi regional working conference with national party leadership in attendance
stories.summary: Gerindra's North Sulawesi branch held its 2026 Rapat Kerja Daerah (Rakerda) at Four Points by Sheraton Manado on May 23, attended by DPP Harian Chairman Sufmi Dasco Ahmad and thousands of cadres; the Bitung mayor publicly joined Gerindra at the event. The conference targeted winning three national parliament seats in North Sulawesi at the next election.
